lore.name: Millbrook
lore.text: A small village in the valley, between the iron mine to the north and the city down the valley. Most folk farm, mine or trade.

lore.name: the forge
lore.text: Brena Ashford's forge on the east side of the village. Her father ran it before her.

lore.name: the Gilded Goose
lore.text: Millbrook's only inn. Old Pell has run it for thirty years, and everyone in the village drinks there.

lore.name: the village gate
lore.text: The west gate, on the road in from the city. The village guard keeps it, and Corporal Hale stands it most days.

lore.name: the mine road
lore.text: The road north from Millbrook to the iron mine. Ore for the forge comes down it on carts.

lore.name: the bandits on the mine road
lore.text: Bandits have been raiding the mine road for two weeks. They rob the carts, and hardly any ore gets through.

lore.name: the attack on a merchant cart
lore.text: Bandits attacked a merchant cart on the mine road this morning.

lore.name: the bandit raid
lore.text: Bandits raided a shop in Millbrook during the night and made off with goods and coin.

lore.name: the bandit raid that was driven off
lore.text: A bandit raid on a shop in Millbrook was driven off during the night.

lore.name: the city
lore.text: A big walled city three days down the valley. The city guard is based there.

lore.name: Brena Ashford
lore.knowsMore: smithing, iron and the mine road
lore.text: Millbrook's blacksmith. She took over the forge from her father ten years ago. Gruff, but honest.

lore.name: Brena's business
lore.text: Brena is the best smith in the valley, but she has no head for business.

lore.name: Old Pell
lore.text: The innkeeper of the Gilded Goose. He hears every rumour in Millbrook, and sells them like ale.

lore.name: Corporal Hale
lore.knowsMore: who comes and goes through the gate
lore.text: A guard on the village gate. He got the post through his uncle, not his sword arm.

lore.name: Rook
lore.text: The bandits on the mine road answer to a man called Rook. They say he was in the city guard once. He keeps camp at the north end of the road.

lore.name: Tomas Ashford
lore.text: Brena's younger brother. He joined the city guard and stopped writing home three months ago.

lore.name: Tomas seen in the city
lore.text: A guardsman matching Tomas Ashford's description was seen drinking in the city with a hooded stranger.

lore.name: the mayor
lore.text: Aldric Voss, mayor of Millbrook. A wealthy man who keeps the village's money, and his own, in a vault at his house.

lore.name: the robbery of the mayor's vault
lore.text: Last month someone robbed the mayor's vault. Nobody has been caught.

lore.name: the mayor's household
lore.text: The mayor's wife, Odile, runs his household. Their son Bram is away at school in the city.

lore.name: the guard captain
lore.text: Captain Reyna Holt commands Millbrook's small guard. Strict, and nobody's fool.

lore.name: the missing tax money
lore.text: The guard captain has been asking questions about missing tax money.
